text: I wanted to say that I was very impressed with the staff on my first visit. I've never seen a clinic where all the staff greet you with a wai (traditional Thai greeting) and are so friendly. The clinic is spacious and comfortable, and the doctor speaks softly and has a wonderful personality. I highly recommend this clinic because everything you experience is done with professionalism. Plus, the clinic is next to Central Bang Yai market, so there are plenty of food options nearby. You can finish your dental work and then go shopping at Central.

text: I recently finished orthodontic treatment almost 3 months ago, and I'm not very happy with it. The initial consultation said one thing, and during treatment, they said something completely different. They didn't provide much detail about the treatment plan; I had to constantly ask questions. I initially heard from people around me that this place was good and had many patients, but my experience was really disappointing. I had braces to correct my protruding teeth, but I'm indifferent to the results; in fact, my lower teeth seem even more crooked. How can they fix something that doesn't look like it was fixed at all? And I didn't ask for free treatment; I paid for it, so it should have been worth the money. This is an unbiased review based on my own experience.
